name: const unsafe fn copy_nonoverlapping < T > (src : * const T , dst : * mut T , count : usize)
rule: When `count * size_of::<T>()` is zero, every pointer, including a null or dangling pointer, satisfies the read/write validity requirement; both pointers must still be aligned to `align_of::<T>()`.
api: const unsafe fn copy_nonoverlapping < T > (src : * const T , dst : * mut T , count : usize)
